name: Circuit Board
instruction:
Create a 3D model of a circuit board. 

The board should be rectangular with various electronic components. 

Include resistors, capacitors, and integrated circuits. 

Add a few LEDs for visual indication. 

Finally, place connectors on the edges for external connections.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a circuit board.
The circuit board is rectangular in shape.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The electronic components are distributed across the board.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The components are properly positioned on the board.
There is adequate space between components to avoid overlap.
Connectors are placed on the edges for accessibility.
Object distance and contact: All components are securely mounted on the board.
There are no gaps between the components and the board surface.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components (resistors, capacitors, integrated circuits, LEDs, connectors) are accurately represented.
The shape of the board is correctly modeled as rectangular.
